method: Rasterized existing SVG files with rsvg-convert, opened the resulting local PNG images, and checked labels, container and square count. Polygon coordinates are checked numerically by the independent artifact checker; visual inspection is not a validity certificate.
observations: The n=12 candidate shows twelve unit squares, including three tilted interior squares; n=11 and n=16 controls contain tilted squares and unused area. The initialization-failure view is empty and clearly labeled INVALID DEBUG. Selected geometry is preserved in SVG and pose JSON; PNG previews are temporary.
